Get all SAML attributes by page.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/samlAttribute

Get all SAML attributes by page.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK

*/*

Example (auto)

int64

SamlAttribute[]
